verdict.rationale: A cloud hosting platform could plausibly offer built-in AI insights or suggestions about a user's apps, metrics or costs, so this axis applies. The evidence only shows infrastructure for running the user's own agents (Sprites, MCP server hosting, an experimental flyctl MCP server) and building blocks such as pgvector and GPUs. Nothing documents Fly.io itself generating insights or suggestions from customer data inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
